title: Handling multiple tracking area codes from the lower layers

entities.name: TAI Selection Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for selecting a TAI when UE receives multiple TACs from lower layers in satellite E-UTRAN cells. UE constructs TAIs by concatenating current PLMN identity with each TAC and selects based on TAI list membership and forbidden area lists.

entities.name: Tracking Area Identity
entities.description: Identity constructed by concatenating PLMN identity and Tracking Area Code. Used to identify tracking areas in E-UTRAN.

entities.name: Tracking Area Code
entities.description: Code received from lower layers that identifies a tracking area within a PLMN.

entities.name: TAI List
entities.description: List of TAIs stored in the UE that the UE is registered to or allowed to use.

entities.name: Forbidden Tracking Areas for Roaming
entities.description: List of TAIs where roaming is not allowed for the UE.

entities.name: Forbidden Tracking Areas for Regional Provision of Service
entities.description: List of TAIs where regional service provision is not allowed for the UE.

entities.name: TAI belongs to TAI list
entities.description: Condition where at least one constructed TAI is present in the UE's TAI list.

entities.name: TAI not in forbidden lists
entities.description: Condition where TAI is not in forbidden tracking areas for roaming or regional provision of service lists.

entities.name: Geographical location best match
entities.description: Condition where UE can determine which TAI best represents its geographical location.

entities.name: Current TAI
entities.description: The TAI selected by the UE as its current tracking area identity.

relations.description: TAI selection procedure involves constructing TAIs from multiple TACs and PLMN identity
TAI is constructed by concatenating PLMN identity and TAC
TAI selection is guarded by whether any TAI belongs to the UE's TAI list
TAI selection is guarded by whether TAI is in forbidden tracking area lists
TAI selection is guarded by whether UE can determine geographical best match
TAI selection procedure establishes the current TAI for the UE
TAI list membership condition requires access to the UE's TAI list
Forbidden area check condition requires access to forbidden tracking areas for roaming list
Forbidden area check condition requires access to forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service list
